title: x-archify CALM metadata entry
description: Vendor-prefixed metadata entry added to a CALM architecture document's `metadata` array. Maps custom CALM node-types to archify rendering hints (component type and optional legend label).

x-archify.description: Archify rendering hints for custom CALM node-types.

node-types.description: A map from CALM node-type identifiers to archify rendering hints. Each key is a node-type string (e.g. 'module', 'plugin'); the value controls how nodes of that type are visualised.

NodeTypeHint.title: Node-type hint
NodeTypeHint.description: Archify rendering hint for a single CALM node-type.

component-type.description: The archify component type that controls the icon and color of nodes of this type in the rendered diagram.

legend-label.description: Human-readable label shown for this component-type in the diagram legend. Overrides the archify default label (e.g. 'Backend' can be overridden to 'Module').

sublabel.description: Name of a CALM node property whose value will be shown as a secondary line below the node label in the diagram (e.g. 'core-npm-package'). Only rendered if the node has that property and its value is a string.

tag.description: Name of a CALM node property whose value will be shown as a tag badge on the node (e.g. 'ddd-layer'). Only rendered if the node has that property and its value is a string.
